Flavor-Text: This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores poison and electricity in two different sacs inside its body.

Name: Toxtricity
Flavor-Text: As it gulps down stagnant water and generates electricity in its body, a sound like a rhythm played by a bass guitar reverberates all around.

Name: Toxtricity
Effects: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use attacks.
Flavor-Text: The jolts of electricity it launches by violently strumming the protrusions on its chest easily exceed 15,000 volts.

Name: Morpeko
Effects: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand.
Flavor-Text: It has a small stomach. If it isn’t constantly eating the seeds it keeps in its pockets, it will get hungry immediately.

Name: Miraidon
Effects: Discard 2 [L] Energy from this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

Effects: Attach up to 2 Basic Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon.
Discard an Energy from this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: Created from the DNA of Mew, this Pokémon is a dangerous combination of overwhelming power and a savage heart.

During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use attacks.

Name: Mew
Effects: This attack does 40 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

Ability-Effect: This Pokémon can use the attacks of any of your Benched Pokémon. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)
Effects: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: Marill
Flavor-Text: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it’s fine even in rivers with strong currents.

Name: Azumarill
Effects: Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
Flavor-Text: By keeping still and listening intently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast-moving rivers.

Name: Espeon
Effects: Devolve each of your opponent’s evolved Pokémon by putting the highest Stage Evolution card on it into your opponent’s hand.
Flavor-Text: It uses the fine fur on its body to sense movement in the air and predict the weather…as well as its foes’ thoughts.

Effects: This attack does 30 damage for each of your Pokémon in play.
ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Flavor-Text: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

Name: Drifloon
Effects: You may shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.
Flavor-Text: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “signpost for wandering spirits.”

Name: Cresselia
Effects: Heal 30 damage from this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

Name: Chandelure
Effects: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Burned and Confused.
Flavor-Text: Being consumed in Chandelure’s flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

Name: Xerneas
Effects: Search your deck for up to 2 Stadium cards, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
Flavor-Text: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.

Name: Comfey
Effects: Heal 80 damage from 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: It prefers areas with lots of flowers. A Comfey adorned with flowers is a happy Comfey, and the flowers gain healing effects.

Name: Cosmog
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon came from another universe. Its gaseous body is so light that even a gentle breeze can blow it away.

Name: Cosmoem
Effects: During your opponent’s next turn, this Pokémon takes 60 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
Flavor-Text: The absorption of starlight fuels this Pokémon’s growth. The shell that encases it is harder than any known material.

Name: Lunala
Effects: This attack does 20 more damage for each Energy card in your discard pile.
Flavor-Text: Known as the Beast That Calls the Moon, this Pokémon lives by taking in any and all light and converting it into its own energy.

Name: Gimmighoul
Effects: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
Flavor-Text: It wanders around, carrying an old coin on its back. It survives by draining the life-force from humans who try to pick up its coin.

Name: Groudon
Effects: This attack also does 20 damage to each of your Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
Flavor-Text: Groudon is said to have expanded the reach of dry land by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled ferociously against Kyogre.

Name: Lucario
Effects: This attack also does 60 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
Flavor-Text: By reading the auras of all things, it can tell how others are feeling from over half a mile away.

Name: Seismitoad
Effects: During your opponent’s next turn, whenever they try to use a Trainer card from their hand, they flip a coin. If tails, your opponent discards that Trainer card instead of using it.
Flavor-Text: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.

Name: Lycanroc
Effects: If this Pokémon was damaged by an attack during your opponent’s last turn, this attack does that much more damage.
Flavor-Text: This Lycanroc has an extremely vicious temperament. It will happily sustain injuries for the sake of taking down its opponent.

Name: Koraidon
Effects: Discard 2 [F] Energy from this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

Flavor-Text: Females are more sensitive to smells than males. While foraging, they’ll use their whiskers to check wind direction and stay downwind of predators.

Name: Nidorina
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, you may use this Ability. Heal 30 damage from 1 of your Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: The horn on its head has atrophied. It’s thought that this happens so Nidorina’s children won’t get poked while their mother is feeding them.

Name: Alolan Meowth
Effects: Draw a card.
Flavor-Text: It’s accustomed to luxury because it used to live with Alolan royalty. As a result, it’s very picky about food.

Name: Gengar ex

Name: Umbreon ex

ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: Murkrow

Flavor-Text: If spotted, it will lure an unwary person into chasing it, then lose the pursuer on mountain trails.

Name: Scraggy
Effects: Your opponent shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards.
Flavor-Text: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

Name: Zorua
Flavor-Text: To protect themselves from danger, they hide their true identities by transforming into people and Pokémon.

Name: Zoroark
Ability-Effect: As long as this Pokémon is on your Bench, your Active Pokémon’s Retreat Cost is [C][C] less.
Flavor-Text: Each has the ability to fool a large group of people simultaneously. They protect their lair with illusory scenery.

Name: Deino
Flavor-Text: It nests deep inside a cave. Food there is scarce, so Deino will sink its teeth into anything that moves and attempt to eat it.

Name: Zweilous
Flavor-Text: The two heads have different likes and dislikes. Because the heads fight with each other, Zweilous gets stronger without needing to rely on others.

Name: Hydreigon
Effects: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, discard an Energy from your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: It’s said that Hydreigon grew ferocious because people in times long past loathed it, considering it to be evil incarnate and attacking it relentlessly.

Name: Yveltal
Ability-Effect: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon can’t be healed.
Flavor-Text: It’s said that when its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.

Name: Galarian Meowth
Effects: Draw a card.
This attack does 10 damage for each card in your hand.
Flavor-Text: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon’s body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

Name: Jirachi ex
Effects: Draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.
This attack’s damage isn’t affected by Weakness or Resistance, or by any effects on your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: Dialga
Effects: Shuffle up to 3 in any combination of Pokémon and Basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.
Flavor-Text: A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when Dialga was born.

Name: Ferrothorn
Effects: This attack does 50 damage to each of your opponent’s Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) This Pokémon also does 130 damage to itself.
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.

Name: Solgaleo
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is on your Bench, you may use this Ability. Search your deck for up to 2 Basic [M] Energy cards and attach them to this Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.
Effects: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: Solgaleo was once known as the Beast That Devours the Sun. Energy in the form of light radiates boundlessly from it.

Name: Zacian
Effects: If this Pokémon has a Pokémon Tool attached, this attack does 40 more damage.
During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use Slashing Strike.
Flavor-Text: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King’s Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.

Name: Zamazenta
Effects: Before doing damage, discard all Pokémon Tools from your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
During your opponent’s next turn, this Pokémon takes 50 less damage from attacks (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
Flavor-Text: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master’s Shield. It was feared and respected by all.

Name: Gholdengo
Effects: If you have exactly 30 cards in your hand, take 2 Prize cards. If you do, shuffle your hand into your deck.

Name: Hakamo-o
Flavor-Text: It fires itself up by striking its scales with force as it dances. Its roar is a battle cry.

Name: Kommo-o
Flavor-Text: It bashes its scales to test its opponents’ mettle. The sound of struck Kommo-o scales frightens weaker foes and sends them running.

Name: Meowth
Effects: Draw a card.
Flavor-Text: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines, too.

Name: Kangaskhan
Effects: This attack does 10 more damage for each damage counter on this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: It raises its offspring in its belly pouch. It lets its baby out to play only when it feels safe to do so.

Name: Ditto

Any attached cards, damage counters, Special Conditions, turns in play, and any other effects remain on the new Pokémon. If you switched a Pokémon in this way, put this card into your deck. Then, shuffle your deck.
Flavor-Text: It can freely recombine its own cellular structure to transform into other life-forms.

Name: Eevee
Effects: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you put an Item card you find there on the bottom of your opponent’s deck.
Flavor-Text: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.

Name: Lugia
Effects: Discard a [R] Energy, a [W] Energy, and a [L] Energy from this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.

Name: Hisuian Zorua
Flavor-Text: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

Name: Hisuian Zoroark
Effects: Place damage counters on your opponent’s Active Pokémon until its remaining HP is 50.
Flavor-Text: With its disheveled white fur, it looks like an embodiment of death. Heedless of its own safety, Zoroark attacks its nemeses with a bitter energy so intense, it lacerates Zoroark’s own body.

Name: Minior
Effects: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon, and this attack does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
Flavor-Text: It feeds on dust in the atmosphere. The color of its core is said to be determined by the composition of the dust it eats.

Name: Maushold
Effects: Flip a coin for each Maushold you have in play. For each heads, discard the top 2 cards of your opponent’s deck.
Flavor-Text: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

Name: Switch
Description: Switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.

Name: Ultra Ball
Description: You can use this card only if you discard 2 other cards from your hand.Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.

Name: Alolan Exeggutor
Ability-Effect: If this Pokémon has 6 or more [G] Energy attached, it gets +250 HP.
Effects: Heal 50 damage from this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

Name: Moltres
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, if you have Articuno and Zapdos in play, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic [R] Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon.
Effects: Discard 2 Energy from this Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: It’s one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.

Name: Lapras
Effects: Search your deck for a Supporter card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
Flip a coin. If heads, your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.
Flavor-Text: Able to understand human speech and very intelligent, it loves to swim in the sea with people on its back.

Name: Articuno
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, if you have Moltres and Zapdos in play, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic [W] Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon.
Effects: This attack does 30 damage to each of your opponent’s Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
Flavor-Text: It’s said that this Pokémon’s beautiful blue wings are made of ice. Articuno flies over snowy mountains, its long tail fluttering along behind it.

Name: Zapdos
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, if you have Moltres and Articuno in play, you may use this Ability. Attach a Basic [L] Energy card from your hand to this Pokémon.
Effects: This Pokémon also does 60 damage to itself.
Flavor-Text: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.

Name: Toxtricity
Effects: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use attacks.
Flavor-Text: The jolts of electricity it launches by violently strumming the protrusions on its chest easily exceed 15,000 volts.

Name: Morpeko
Effects: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand.
Flavor-Text: It has a small stomach. If it isn’t constantly eating the seeds it keeps in its pockets, it will get hungry immediately.

Name: Drifloon
Effects: You may shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.
Flavor-Text: Because of the way it floats aimlessly, an old folktale calls it a “signpost for wandering spirits.”

Name: Chandelure
Effects: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Burned and Confused.
Flavor-Text: Being consumed in Chandelure’s flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.

Name: Lycanroc
Effects: If this Pokémon was damaged by an attack during your opponent’s last turn, this attack does that much more damage.
Flavor-Text: This Lycanroc has an extremely vicious temperament. It will happily sustain injuries for the sake of taking down its opponent.

Name: Alolan Meowth
Effects: Draw a card.
Flavor-Text: It’s accustomed to luxury because it used to live with Alolan royalty. As a result, it’s very picky about food.

Name: Scraggy
Effects: Your opponent shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards.
Flavor-Text: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.

Name: Galarian Meowth
Effects: Draw a card.
This attack does 10 damage for each card in your hand.
Flavor-Text: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon’s body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.

Name: Gholdengo
Effects: If you have exactly 30 cards in your hand, take 2 Prize cards. If you do, shuffle your hand into your deck.
Flip 3 coins. This attack does 50 damage for each heads.
Flavor-Text: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.

Name: Kommo-o
Flavor-Text: It bashes its scales to test its opponents’ mettle. The sound of struck Kommo-o scales frightens weaker foes and sends them running.

Name: Meowth
Effects: Draw a card.
Flavor-Text: It loves things that sparkle. When it sees a shiny object, the gold coin on its head shines, too.

Name: Hisuian Zorua
Flavor-Text: A once-departed soul, returned to life in Hisui. Derives power from resentment, which rises as energy atop its head and takes on the forms of foes. In this way, Zorua vents lingering malice.

Name: Maushold
Effects: Flip a coin for each Maushold you have in play. For each heads, discard the top 2 cards of your opponent’s deck.
Flavor-Text: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.

Name: Fuecoco ex
Effects: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Burned.
This attack does 70 damage for each Prize card you have taken.
ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: Greninja ex
Effects: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon for each damage counter on that Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: Pikachu ex
Effects: Search your deck for any number of Basic Pokémon and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.
Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.
ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: Pikachu ex
Effects: You may attach any number of Basic Energy cards from your hand to your Pokémon in any way you like.
This Pokémon also does 30 damage to itself.
ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: Mewtwo ex
Effects: This attack does 50 damage to each of your opponent’s Pokémon ex. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use attacks.
ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: Mew ex
Ability-Effect: This Pokémon can use the attacks of any of your Benched Pokémon. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)
Effects: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: Sylveon ex
Effects: This attack does 50 damage for each type of Basic Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.
ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: Gengar ex
Ability-Effect: If this Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent’s Pokémon, flip a coin. If heads, the Attacking Pokémon is Knocked Out.
Effects: Place 13 damage counters on 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon.
ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: Jirachi ex
Effects: Draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.
This attack’s damage isn’t affected by Weakness or Resistance, or by any effects on your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: Salamence ex
Effects: Put up to 3 [N] Pokémon from your discard pile onto your Bench.
Discard the top 2 cards of your deck.
ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: Mewtwo ex
Effects: This attack does 50 damage to each of your opponent’s Pokémon ex. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t use attacks.
ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: Mew ex
Ability-Effect: This Pokémon can use the attacks of any of your Benched Pokémon. (You still need the necessary Energy to use each attack.)
Effects: You may switch this Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: Mew
Effects: This attack does 40 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

Name: Mew
Effects: This attack does 40 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

Name: Mew
Effects: This attack does 40 more damage for each Energy attached to your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
Flavor-Text: So rare that it is still said to be a mirage by many experts. Only a few people have seen it worldwide.

Name: Pikachu
Effects: Flip a coin. If tails, Pikachu does 10 damage to itself.
Flavor-Text: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can cause lightning storms.

Name: Charizard
Pok\u00e9mon-Power-Effect: As often as you like during your turn (before your attack), you may turn all Energy attached to Charizard into [R] Energy for the rest of the turn. This power can’t be used if Charizard is Asleep, Confused, or Paralyzed.
Effects: Discard 2 Energy cards attached to Charizard in order to use this attack.
Flavor-Text: Spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. Known to unintentionally cause forest fires.

Name: Misty
Description: Discard 2 of the other cards in your hand in order to play this card. If this turn’s attack does damage to the Defending Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance), and if the attacking Pokémon has Misty in its name, the attack does 20 more damage to the Defending Pokémon.

Name: Erika’s Jigglypuff
Effects: You and your opponent remove 1 damage counter from each of your Pokémon with damage counters on them.
If the Defending Pokémon has no damage counters on it, this attack does 40 damage. If it has any damage counters on it, this attack does 10 damage.

Name: Sneasel
Effects: Flip 3 coins. This attack does 10 damage times the number of heads.
Flip a coin for each of your Pokémon in play (including this one). This attack does 20 damage times the number of heads.
Flavor-Text: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

Name: Shining Celebi
Effects: Remove a number of damage counters from 1 of your Benched Pokémon equal to the number of [W] Energy cards attached to Shining Celebi. If the Pokémon has fewer damage counters than that, remove all of them.
Flip a number of coins equal to the number of Energy attached to the Defending Pokémon. If you get 1 or more heads, the Defending Pokémon is now Asleep, Confused, or Poisoned (your choice).
Flavor-Text: It is worshipped as a god of the forest. It appears only in undisturbed old-growth forests.

Name: Lugia
Pok\u00e9-BODY-Effect: Whenever you attach a [R], [W], or [P] basic Energy card from your hand to Lugia, Lugia’s type (color) becomes the same as that Energy card type until the end of the turn.
Effects: This attack does 10 damage times the number of Energy cards attached to the Defending Pokémon.
Discard an Energy card attached to Lugia.

Name: Delcatty
Pok\u00e9-POWER-Effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may discard 1 Energy card from your hand. Then draw up to 3 cards from your deck. This power can’t be used if Delcatty is affected by a Special Condition.
Effects: Does 10 damage times the amount of Energy attached to all of your Active Pokémon.

Name: Dark Tyranitar
Effects: Does 10 damage plus 10 more damage for each Energy attached to Dark Tyranitar.
Does 20 damage to each of your opponent’s Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
If the Defending Pokémon is Pokémon-ex, this attack does 70 damage plus 50 more damage.

Name: Scizor ex
Pok\u00e9-BODY-Effect: As long as Scizor ex’s remaining HP is 60 or less, Scizor ex does 40 more damage to the Defending Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
Effects: During your opponent’s next turn, any damage done to Scizor ex by attacks is reduced by 20 (after applying Weakness and Resistance).
If the Defending Pokémon is an Evolved Pokémon, this attack does 50 damage plus 30 more damage.
ex-Rule: When your Pokémon ex is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: Metagross
Pok\u00e9-POWER-Effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may look at the top 4 cards of your deck, choose 1 of them, and put it into your hand. Put the 3 other cards on the bottom of your deck in any order. This power can’t be used if Metagross is affected by a Special Condition.
Effects: You may discard as many Energy cards as you like attached to your Pokémon in play. If you do, this attack does 30 damage plus 20 more damage for each Energy card you discarded.

Name: Palkia LV.X
Pok\u00e9-POWER-Effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may have your opponent switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon. Then, you switch 1 of the Defending Pokémon with 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. This power can’t be used if Palkia is affected by a Special Condition.
Effects: You may move all Energy cards attached to Palkia to your Benched Pokémon in any way you like. (Ignore this effect if you don’t have any Benched Pokémon.)
Level-Up-Rule: Put this card onto your Active Palkia. Palkia LV.X can use any attack, Poké-Power, or Poké-Body from its previous level.

Name: Uxie
Pok\u00e9-POWER-Effect: Once during your turn, when you put Uxie from your hand onto your Bench, you may draw cards until you have 7 cards in your hand.
Effects: You may put Uxie and all cards attached to it on the bottom of your deck in any order.
Flavor-Text: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

Name: Crobat G
Pok\u00e9-POWER-Effect: Once during your turn, when you put Crobat G from your hand onto your Bench, you may put 1 damage counter on 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon.
Effects: The Defending Pokémon is now Poisoned. Put 2 damage counters instead of 1 on the Defending Pokémon between turns.

Name: Gengar
Pok\u00e9-BODY-Effect: As long as Gengar is your Active Pokémon, if any of your opponent’s Pokémon would be Knocked Out, put that Pokémon in the Lost Zone instead of discarding. (Discard all cards attached to that Pokémon.)
Effects: Look at your opponent’s hand and choose a number of Pokémon you find there up to the number of [P] Energy attached to Gengar. Put the Pokémon you chose in the Lost Zone.
Put 4 damage counters on your opponent’s Pokémon in any way you like.

Name: Darkrai & Cresselia LEGEND
Effects: Choose 2 Energy attached to Darkrai & Cresselia LEGEND and put them in the Lost Zone. If any of your opponent’s Pokémon would be Knocked Out by damage from this attack, put that Pokémon and all cards attached to it in the Lost Zone instead of discarding it.
Move as many damage counters on your opponent’s Pokémon as you like to any of your opponent’s other Pokémon in any way you like.
LEGEND-Rule: Put this card from your hand onto your Bench only with the other half of Darkrai & Cresselia LEGEND.
Dual-LEGEND-Rule: When this Pokémon has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: Darkrai & Cresselia LEGEND
Effects: Choose 2 Energy attached to Darkrai & Cresselia LEGEND and put them in the Lost Zone. If any of your opponent’s Pokémon would be Knocked Out by damage from this attack, put that Pokémon and all cards attached to it in the Lost Zone instead of discarding it.
Move as many damage counters on your opponent’s Pokémon as you like to any of your opponent’s other Pokémon in any way you like.
LEGEND-Rule: Put this card from your hand onto your Bench only with the other half of Darkrai & Cresselia LEGEND.
Dual-LEGEND-Rule: When this Pokémon has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: N
Description: Each player shuffles his or her hand into his or her deck. Then, each player draws a card for each of his or her remaining Prize cards.
Supporter-Rule: You may play only 1 Supporter card during your turn (before your attack).

Name: Rayquaza-EX
Effects: Discard the top 3 cards of your deck. If any of those cards are Energy cards, attach them to this Pokémon.
Discard all basic [R] Energy or all basic [L] Energy attached to this Pokémon. This attack does 60 damage times the number of Energy you discarded.
ex-Rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: Genesect-EX
Ability-Effect: When you attach a Plasma Energy from your hand to this Pokémon, you may switch 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon with his or her Active Pokémon.
Effects: Does 20 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
ex-Rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: M Gardevoir-EX
Effects: This attack does 30 damage times the amount of [Y] Energy attached to all of your Pokémon.
Mega-Evolution-Rule: When 1 of your Pokémon becomes a Mega Evolution Pokémon, your turn ends.
ex-Rule: When a Pokémon-EX has been Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: Greninja BREAK
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), if this Pokémon is your Active Pokémon, you may discard a [W] Energy card from your hand. If you do, put 6 damage counters on 1 of your opponent’s Pokémon.
BREAK-Rule: Greninja BREAK retains the attacks, Abilities, Weakness, Resistance, and Retreat Cost of its previous Evolution.

Name: Solgaleo-GX
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn (before your attack), you may switch your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
Effects: Discard all Energy from this Pokémon.
Search your deck for up to 5 Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)
GX-Rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: Buzzwole-GX
Effects: This attack does 30 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
This Pokémon can’t attack during your next turn.
This attack does 40 damage for each of your remaining Prize cards. (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)
GX-Rule: When your Pokémon-GX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: Pikachu & Zekrom-GX
Effects: Search your deck for up to 3 [L] Energy cards and attach them to 1 of your Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

If this Pokémon has at least 3 extra [L] Energy attached to it (in addition to this attack’s cost), this attack does 170 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.) (You can’t use more than 1 GX attack in a game.)
TAG-TEAM-Rule: When your TAG TEAM is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

Name: Zacian V
Ability-Effect: Once during your turn, you may look at the top 3 cards of your deck and attach any number of [M] Energy cards you find there to this Pokémon. Put the other cards into your hand. If you use this Ability, your turn ends.
Effects: During your next turn, this Pokémon can’t attack.
V-Rule: When your Pokémon V is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: Raikou
Effects: This attack also does 120 damage to 1 of your opponent’s Benched Pokémon. (Don’t apply Weakness and Resistance for Benched Pokémon.)
Flavor-Text: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.

Name: Mew VMAX
Effects: Choose 1 of your Benched Fusion Strike Pokémon’s attacks and use it as this attack.
This attack’s damage isn’t affected by any effects on your opponent’s Active Pokémon.
VMAX-Rule: When your Pokémon VMAX is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 3 Prize cards.

Name: Arceus VSTAR
Ability-Effect: During your turn, you may search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. (You can’t use more than 1 VSTAR Power in a game.)
Effects: Search your deck for up to 3 basic Energy cards and attach them to your Pokémon V in any way you like. Then, shuffle your deck.
VSTAR-Rule: When your Pokémon VSTAR is Knocked Out, your opponent takes 2 Prize cards.

Name: Magikarp
Effects: Flip 2 coins. If both of them are heads, this attack does 20 more damage.
Flavor-Text: An underpowered, pathetic Pokémon. It may jump high on rare occasions but never more than seven feet.
